title: 第15章 赤鸦道兵第4章 黄巾力士修士证
content_zh:
帝国那边大日紫气量少，采集困难，一标准单位的大日紫气都能卖到十多功勋。
只有真正有钱的修士，才有财力用珍贵的大日紫气代替一般的大日火气来修炼赤鸦炼日诀。
贵归贵，但也物超所值，用大日紫气修炼出的赤鸦炼日诀，其法力强度与品质都要高出用普通大日火气修炼出的。
惶惶紫气，天生贵胄，死生交融，内蕴天威。
强的不是一星半点。
陆羽不知道自己能不能一直用大日紫气将赤鸦炼日诀走到底，但是现在他还能炼，就按照现在的情况接着炼。
往后他还要在两界厮混，地仙道的修行刚刚开始，能强一点总归没有坏处。
在炼化大日紫气，增长赤鸦炼日诀法力的同时，陆羽也在琢磨着赤鸦炼日诀配套的道兵事宜。
赤鸦炼日诀在修炼的过程中，可以用自身所炼赤鸦道种炼化禽鸟，炼制赤鸦道兵。
功法配套炼制出来的赤鸦道兵，是地仙道修士最好的帮手。
道兵与修士休戚相关，可以自由进出道土，辅助修士采炼天地灵气，按照修士的命令义无反顾地参与战斗。
自曝，舍命，都不在话下。
“赤鸦炼日诀需要的禽类，紫岳城遗迹中的赤睛妖乌就很不错！”
陆羽思量着，很快就找到适合炼制赤鸦道兵的禽鸟。
帝国那边，普通的乌鸦肯定好找，但是稍微有点力量，向着妖兽进化的禽鸟价格都能飙上天去。
陆羽有炼制道兵的需求，其他地仙道修士同样也有这样的需求。
僧多粥少，这类不可共享的资源类事物价格都普遍偏高。
这与可以复制的功法、知识、记忆类事物形成了鲜明的对比。
这也是帝国发展壮大，避不过去的痛点之一。
除非能让帝国发现新世界，获得一片新的资源地，不然这种痛苦就还要持续很长一段时间。

最近，陆羽倒是听说，帝国那边正在大力发展航天航空工业，致力于飞往地星之外，寻找宇宙之中的资源.......
就是不知道他有生之年，能不能见到帝国的金红龙旗插在宇宙星空中。
.......
4月15日，异界晴。
早晨采过大日紫气之后，陆羽去肖玉的药屋瞧了瞧肖玉的状态。
经过一夜的休息，肖玉恢复了些状态，但还是很虚弱。
作死服下“仙丹”，本就有些伤势在身的肖玉一下子被打倒了。
陆羽的帮忙也只是让她稍微恢复了一点元气，想要彻底治好伤，还需要好药与时间。
好药肖玉自然没有，所以她现在只能慢慢熬。
陆羽来时，肖玉脸色一片苍白，病殃殃地躺在床上，整个人都是有气无力的，一副要死的模样。
“可不能让肖玉这个我唯一认识的异界仙师死在这里，没了她，谁还能帮我拿下蛇信村部族.......”
陆羽瞧着肖玉的状态，生怕她一不小心把自己玩死，思索着救治肖玉的办法。
陆羽的练的是赤鸦炼日诀，是最擅长斗战的火法，不善治病驱邪之法，想救肖玉也无从下手。
思来想去，陆羽只能从道土里取出一支生命21号递给肖玉。
“这是什么东西？闻着挺甜的！”
肖玉在陆羽的指点下，打开生命21号的瓶盖，甜腻的味道冲入鼻腔。
有些原始的蛇信村部族里不怎么能吃到糖，让陆羽闻着觉得恶心的甜腻味道，肖玉只觉得好闻，闻着都有些流口水了。
同时肖玉也很好奇，陆羽这个外来的仙师，能拿出什么好东西来。
“这是我从老家带来的辟谷药液，喝下一支，可以十天不食，虽然不能给你治病，但也能给你补充身体所需的营养，有利于你的休养恢复！”
陆羽倒没有隐瞒生命21号的功效，简单得说明了一番。

听见“辟谷”的字眼，肖玉激动得都想从床上爬起来，满眼兴奋。
部族里传承的那半部仙书残卷之中，就记载了一份辟谷丹的炼制之法。
陆羽的老家有辟谷丹，那陆羽是不是也会？
content_en:
The amount of Great Sun Purple Energy in the empire is small and difficult to collect. A standard unit of Great Sun Purple Energy can be sold for more than ten meritorious deeds.
Only truly wealthy monks have the financial resources to use the precious purple energy of the great sun instead of the ordinary fire energy of the great sun to practice the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique.
It's expensive, but it's worth the money. The Red Crow Sun Refining Technique cultivated with the Purple Sun Qi has higher magical power and quality than those cultivated with the ordinary Sun Fire Qi.
The Purple Qi of Panic is born to be noble, the blend of life and death contains the power of Heaven.
Not even the slightest bit stronger.
Lu Yu didn't know if he could continue to use the Purple Sun Qi to complete the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique to the end, but now that he could still practice it, he would continue practicing according to the current situation.
He will have to hang out in the two realms in the future. The cultivation of the Earthly Immortal Way has just begun. There is no harm in being stronger.
While refining the Purple Qi of the Great Sun and increasing the mana of the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, Lu Yu was also thinking about the Taoist weapons supporting the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique.
In the process of practicing the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, you can use the Red Crow Tao Seeds you have refined to refine birds and red crow Tao weapons.
The red crow Taoist soldiers refined with matching exercises are the best helpers for Earth Immortal Taoist monks.
Taoist soldiers are closely related to the monks. They can enter and exit the Taoist land freely, assist the monks in extracting the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and participate in the battle without hesitation according to the monks' orders.
Exposing yourself and risking your life are all a matter of course.
"The birds needed for the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, the Red Eyed Demon Crow in the ruins of Ziyue City are very good!"
Lu Yu thought about it and quickly found a bird suitable for refining the red crow Taoist weapon.
Over in the empire, ordinary crows are certainly easy to find, but with a little bit of power, the price of birds that evolve into monsters can skyrocket.
Lu Yu has a need to refine Taoist weapons, and other Earth Immortal Taoist monks also have such needs.
There are too many monks and too little rice, and the prices of such non-shareable resources are generally high.
This is in sharp contrast to things like skills, knowledge, and memory that can be copied.
This is also one of the pain points that cannot be avoided as the empire grows and grows.
Unless the empire can discover a new world and acquire a new resource land, this pain will continue for a long time.
Recently, Lu Yu heard that the empire was vigorously developing the aerospace industry and was committed to flying beyond the earth and stars to search for resources in the universe...
I just don’t know if he will ever see the empire’s golden and red dragon flag planted in the starry sky in his lifetime.
.......
April 15th, it was sunny in another world.
After collecting the Sun Purple Qi in the morning, Lu Yu went to Xiao Yu's medicine house to check on Xiao Yu's condition.
After a night's rest, Xiao Yu recovered somewhat, but was still very weak.
After taking the "elixir" to die, Xiao Yu, who was already a little injured, was knocked down all of a sudden.
Lu Yu's help only allowed her to recover a little bit of her strength. To completely heal the injury, good medicine and time were needed.
Xiao Yu naturally doesn't have the good medicine, so she can only take her time now.
When Lu Yu came, Xiao Yu's face was pale and she was lying on the bed sickly. Her whole body was weak and she looked like she was about to die.
"I can't let Xiao Yu, the only otherworldly immortal master I know, die here. Without her, who can help me win over the Shexin Village tribe..."
Lu Yu looked at Xiao Yu's condition, fearing that she might accidentally kill him, and thought about ways to treat Xiao Yu.
Lu Yu practiced the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, which was the best fire method for fighting. He was not good at treating diseases and exorcising evil spirits, so he couldn't save Xiao Yu even if he wanted to.
After thinking about it, Lu Yu could only take out a life number 21 from the soil and hand it to Xiao Yu.
"What is this? It smells sweet!"
Under Lu Yu's guidance, Xiao Yu opened the bottle cap of Life No. 21, and the sweet smell rushed into his nose.
Some of the primitive tribes in Shexin Village were unable to eat sweets, so Lu Yu found the sweet smell disgusting. Xiao Yu only found the smell pleasant and even started drooling from the smell.
At the same time Xiao YuI am also very curious about what good things Lu Yu, a foreign immortal master, can come up with.
"This is the anti-grain liquid I brought from my hometown. If you drink one tube, you can go without food for ten days. Although it cannot cure your illness, it can also replenish the nutrients your body needs, which will help you recuperate and recover!"
Lu Yu did not hide the efficacy of Life No. 21, he simply explained it.
Hearing the word "bigu", Xiao Yu was so excited that he wanted to get up from the bed, his eyes filled with excitement.
Among the fragments of the half of the immortal book passed down by the tribe, there is a recipe for refining the Bigu Pill.
Lu Yu's hometown has Bigu Pill, so does Lu Yu also know it?
